**>>> F1002_DOI - DATASET DIGITAL OBJECT IDENTIFIER (DOI) -> string variable

tab F1002_DOI , mis
***************************************************************************

**>>> F1004 - ID VARIABLE - ELECTION STUDY (ALPHABETIC POLITY)
***************************************************************************
* -> string variable - width = 8, e.g. "USA_2008"
gen str F1004 = "AUS_2022"
tab F1004
* control if number of displayed observations equals number of observation in the deposited data-file
***************************************************************************

**>>> F1005 - ID VARIABLE - ELECTION STUDY (NUMERIC POLITY)
***************************************************************************
* This variable consists of eight digits:
* UN Country code (3-digits) + Number of Election Studies witin Country + Election Year
* Example (Iceland 2016): "35202016"
*
* For UN Country Codes, see: "http://unstats.un.org/unsd/methods/m49/m49alpha.htm"
*    or  "https://unstats.un.org/unsd/methods/m49/m49chang.htm" for former states
*
* Note on the fourth character (From Mod6 Codebook): "The fourth character
*    distinguishes between multiple studies conducted within a single
*    country, for the same election."
* If there is only one study F1005 = "F1006_UN" + "0" + "F1009". ALSO: The number of studies
* does not refer to the number of sample components indicated in F1100. For instance,
* a study (e.g. Italy 2018) may consist of two different samples (online and telephone)
* but it is still ONE study for the 2018 Italian election.
gen long F1005 = 03602022
format F1005 %8.0f
tab F1005, mis
***************************************************************************

**>>> F1006 - ID COMPONENT - POLITY CSES CODE
***************************************************************************
** Coding Note:
** This variable is a string variable with the width = 4
* This variable consists of four digits:
* UN Country code (3-digits) + add number of studies within the country for the
*    the same election (From Mod6 Codebook: "The fourth character
*    distinguishes between multiple studies conducted within a single
*    country, for the same election.")
* -> if there is only one study F1006 = "F1006_UN"+"0"
*    NOTE: The number of studies does not refer to the number of
*          sample components indicated in F1100.
*
* For UN Country Codes, see: "http://unstats.un.org/unsd/methods/m49/m49alpha.htm"
*    or  "https://unstats.un.org/unsd/methods/m49/m49chang.htm" for former states
gen str F1006 = "0360"
tab F1006
* control if number of displayed observations equals number of observation in the deposited data-file
***************************************************************************

**>>> F1003_ - ID VARIABLES - RESPONDENT
***************************************************************************
**>>>  ID COMPONENT - RESPONDENT WITHIN ELECTION STUDY -> string variable - width = 10
* -> If the original ID-variable differs in length, convert numeric ID-variable into a
*    string and format the variable with leading zeros:

*    the resulting variable should have a length of 10.

* Control length of F1003
gen F1003_2str = length(F1003_2)

**>>> F1005 - ID VARIABLE - ELECTION STUDY (NUMERIC POLITY)
***************************************************************************
* This variable consists of eight digits:
* UN Country code (3-digits) + Number of Election Studies witin Country + Election Year
* Example (Iceland 2016): "35202016"
*
* For UN Country Codes, see: "http://unstats.un.org/unsd/methods/m49/m49alpha.htm"
*    or  "https://unstats.un.org/unsd/methods/m49/m49chang.htm" for former states
*
* Note on the fourth character (From Mod6 Codebook): "The fourth character
*    distinguishes between multiple studies conducted within a single
*    country, for the same election."
* If there is only one study F1005 = "F1006_UN" + "0" + "F1009". ALSO: The number of studies
* does not refer to the number of sample components indicated in F1100. For instance,
* a study (e.g. Italy 2018) may consist of two different samples (online and telephone)
* but it is still ONE study for the 2018 Italian election.
gen long F1005 = 25002022
format F1005 %8.0f
tab F1005, mis
***************************************************************************

**>>> F1005 - ID VARIABLE - ELECTION STUDY (NUMERIC POLITY)
***************************************************************************
* This variable consists of eight digits:
* UN Country code (3-digits) + Number of Election Studies witin Country + Election Year
* Example (Iceland 2016): "35202016"
*
* For UN Country Codes, see: "http://unstats.un.org/unsd/methods/m49/m49alpha.htm"
*    or  "https://unstats.un.org/unsd/methods/m49/m49chang.htm" for former states
*
* Note on the fourth character (From Mod6 Codebook): "The fourth character
*    distinguishes between multiple studies conducted within a single
*    country, for the same election."
* If there is only one study F1005 = "F1006_UN" + "0" + "F1009". ALSO: The number of studies
* does not refer to the number of sample components indicated in F1100. For instance,
* a study (e.g. Italy 2018) may consist of two different samples (online and telephone)
* but it is still ONE study for the 2018 Italian election.
gen long F1005 = 82602024
format F1005 %8.0f
tab F1005, mis
***************************************************************************

***************************************************************************

**>>> F1005 - ID VARIABLE - ELECTION STUDY (NUMERIC POLITY)
***************************************************************************
* This variable consists of eight digits:
* UN Country code (3-digits) + Number of Election Studies witin Country + Election Year
* Example (Iceland 2016): "35202016"
*
* For UN Country Codes, see: "http://unstats.un.org/unsd/methods/m49/m49alpha.htm"
*    or  "https://unstats.un.org/unsd/methods/m49/m49chang.htm" for former states
*
* Note on the fourth character (From Mod6 Codebook): "The fourth character
*    distinguishes between multiple studies conducted within a single
*    country, for the same election."
* If there is only one study F1005 = "F1006_UN" + "0" + "F1009". ALSO: The number of studies
* does not refer to the number of sample components indicated in F1100. For instance,
* a study (e.g. Italy 2018) may consist of two different samples (online and telephone)
* but it is still ONE study for the 2018 Italian election.
gen long F1005 = 48402021
format F1005 %8.0f
tab F1005, mis
***************************************************************************

***************************************************************************

*    NOTE: The number of studies does not refer to the number of

* For UN Country Codes, see: "http://unstats.un.org/unsd/methods/m49/m49alpha.htm"
*    or  "https://unstats.un.org/unsd/methods/m49/m49chang.htm" for former states
